clips.title: The story
paras: In the Barrens, a Secure Crate waits for a traveler to carry it to Ratchet. Potions and alchemical goods inside are bound for the Eastern Kingdoms.

Couriers, caravans, and goblin ships carry trade between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. When a Barrens caravan misses its departure, travelers take fragile cargo like this Secure Crate down to the coast. It holds potions, alchemical goods, and reagents for associates across the Great Sea. The crate is sealed against the Barrens trails and the sea spray on its voyage.

The crate’s land journey ends at the Ratchet docks, where Wharfmaster Dizzywig oversees shipping. Ratchet is a neutral port for goods crossing the sea, including cargo bound for Blackwater Cove. Dizzywig works under the Steamwheedle Cartel’s ledger, recording parcels and freight before loading them onto the next departing vessel. Ratchet links the Old World with the frontier.
